facts.note: discovered by Henri Moissan while examining rock samples from what is now called Meteor Crater near Canyon Diablo, Arizona, in 1893 · He first misidentified the crystals as diamonds, and only in 1904 identified them as silicon carbide.

a more practical test is electrical conductivity, which gives higher values for moissanite
It has the chemical formula SiC and is a rare mineral, discovered by the French chemist Henri Moissan in 1893.
